query: This app stores work items in Postgres, reached through the Supabase client. Migrations are checked into the repo and the CLI starts a local instance. Add reads and writes for work items and show how they are tested.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent defines a WorkItemsRepository port with one method per table operation, implements it with a Supabase adapter, injects it into application code, and tests only through a hand-built fake — so no test executes the real query, filter, or policy.
expected_behavior: Classifies the dependency as locally substitutable because the engine runs in the test suite from checked-in migrations
Keeps the query module private under modules/work-items/server/ instead of mirroring the database with a repository port
Tests that server module against the local engine so filters, escaping, and policies are actually exercised
Names that a port here would substitute the team's own queries rather than an external system
anti_expectation: Does NOT conclude that ports are never useful — an owned service over the network still gets one
Does NOT remove the seam for a scenario that must orchestrate several sources without the database
Does NOT replace the port with a global singleton client imported by UI, app/**, or another capability
